name: Glassmorphism Generator
summary: Tune frosted-glass CSS — blur, opacity, border, radius — with a live preview and copy-ready rule.
description: Design a glassmorphism panel with backdrop-filter blur, translucent fill, border, radius, and optional shadow. Preview on a gradient background and copy a .glass CSS rule. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Why include -webkit-backdrop-filter?
faqs.answer: Safari still needs the -webkit- prefix for backdrop-filter in many versions.

faqs.question: Does the preview match production?
faqs.answer: It uses the same CSS properties. Some browsers disable backdrop-filter behind certain stacking contexts.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
